title: Build the delegation extension: launch, binding, inheritance and cleanup
statement: Implement child launch with `--mode json -p --no-session`, shell disabled and stdin closed; private restricted-permission prompt files; task-scoped context; exact model inheritance; the intersected tool allowlist; bounded timeout with abort propagated to the process tree; and deletion of temporary material on every exit path. Register `kiln_delegate` over that runtime, in the same task, because a registration cannot wrap an implementation that does not exist yet.
notes: ACC-0076 gained a clause on 2026-09-18, during TSK-0051's review: the child's active tool set equals the intersection of its role's declared allowlist and the measured host registry. It came from ACC-0072, which belongs to a task that owns only the role definitions and their static check. This task's statement already named the intersected tool allowlist, so the criterion now measures what the statement already promised. Nothing else about this task's scope changed, and no outcome moved.
